keep_playing_why: In A I was reading a ring and timing a hold within a minute, I could tell when I got better (hit gold from the air, charged lance, ride a gust lane) and I wanted another pass after losing to Kite. In B I spent nine minutes lighting one stela with no score, no clock and nothing to beat, and I was stuck in a crack for most of it.
better_made_why: A is consistent: readable HUD, always-on music that changes per rival, a sting on win or loss, punchy lance crack and thud, big hit text, no stuck states. B has the prettier 3D court and nice notes UI, but the camera clipped into walls in the crack and showed black frames, the assist reported stuck every time, the Use grab often missed the first time, and there was almost no music.
